drafts.text: Simon Willison gave Qwen 3.8 27B, running locally in LM Studio, only the raw weights of small game-playing networks. With no tools it named Pac-Man, Pong and Breakout after 46 to 65 minutes of reasoning each, and missed Freeway. Logs are public.
drafts.why: An independent laptop reproduction of a weight-reading result, with public logs and a stated failure case.

drafts.text: Hugging Face published The Ultimate MoE Training Handbook, built from about 800k GPU hours of experiments: expert layout, all-to-all costs, silent slowdowns and routing choices for teams training mixture-of-experts models. Free to read.
drafts.why: An open, measured training guide that makes MoE training choices reproducible for smaller teams.

drafts.text: ARC Prize verified Inkling 2 Small from Thinking Machines: 81.7% on ARC-AGI-2 at $0.27 a task, and 96.5% on ARC-AGI-1 at $0.08 a task, ahead of every open-weight model it has evaluated.
drafts.why: A third-party verified score with cost per task, from the benchmark's own maintainers.
